reviewItem.question: Does "Storage version of `clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io` changes v2beta1 → v2" mean a change to migration:kyverno|name=clustercleanuppolicies-storage-version-migration (migration-required)?

proposed.statement: From 1.12.6 to 1.13.0, the storage version of the clustercleanuppolicies.kyverno.io CRD moves from v2beta1 to v2, so existing ClusterCleanupPolicy objects need a storage version migration and a status.storedVersions update before v2beta1 is removed in a later release.
